statement: The attempted repair treats coefficient-preserving simultaneous fixed-component packaging as if it could create additional first-order base directions. For the exact fibre-product representation, its base tangent image is the intersection of the component base tangent images, so it cannot enlarge reachability.
mechanism: Dual-number tangent vectors into a fibre product are exactly compatible tuples with a common base tangent; the universal property gives both inclusions in the image-intersection equality.
broken_transfer_assumption: Coupling fixed selected component witness spaces over the same branch can recover total-class Hodge directions that are not already liftable componentwise.
scope_guard: Only fixed selected component local representable charts and ordinary first-order tangents. No impossibility claim for changing-decomposition, correspondence, Picard-type, flag-incidence, stacky or higher-order representations.
competing_diagnoses_rejected: source incompleteness alone: rejected for this exact fibre-product claim because the non-expansion follows formally from the representation definition
H4d1b detector incompleteness: rejected because this atom starts from actual tangent images, not detector vanishing
